modules.module_title: Assist in cleaning and maintaining the hygiene of an elderly's room

pcs.pc_description: assist in cleaning/ Clean (dusting, sweeping, mopping) the living area to include kitchen and toilet used by the elderly person
sanitise the areas of the house frequently used by the elderly person
assist in washing/ drying/ ironing the clothes/ sheets/ covers regularly used by/ for the elderly person
remove smell/ stains/ spills, if any, from the sheets/ clothes/ undergarments of the elderly person and sanitise the same
empty garbage bins, transfer the waste to the disposal area and clean and sanitise the area
organise the wardrobe neatly in order to facilitate easy identification and retrieval of clothes
clean and maintain utensils/ kitchen equipment/ appliances
organise the objects in room of the elderly person keeping in mind the purpose, safety and hygiene
maintain the bed and change the bed/ pillow/ quilt covers regularly

modules.module_title: Establishing and maintaining a safe, secure and hygienic environment for the elderly person

pcs.pc_description: maintain a safe and hygienic environment with the support of family members
organize furniture appropriately and keep the floors dry to minimize the risk of falling, slipping and tripping by the elderly
prevent injury or accident of the elderly person by getting the safety equipment, such as railings and walking sticks to enhance mobility
record and report to appropriate person about any accident/ injury/ pain/ illness/ other emergencies and seek assistance when required
maintain record of relevant helplines and immediate family, doctor and neighbor's contact details
